direction_item: product obligation (4): integrate accepted Frontier components in the cycle they are promoted and never wait for them
adopt_mode: abstain_and_disclose (INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.adoption.adopt_mode): emitted labels keep the product's own counter_status; abstained rows stay visible as explicitly-unevidenced rows and are COUNTED, never silently dropped

frozen_rules.policy: byte-identical copy of the accepted mount; product/query/counter_label_gate.py re-hashes it before every use and refuses to run on mismatch. No rubric, lexicon, threshold or bar is edited by the product.

byte_identity_check.method: each vendored file re-hashed in the adopting cycle and compared with the accepted mount under /tmp/lex_accepted/frontier/frontier-counter-anchor-classifier
byte_identity_check.result: all 9 files byte-identical; RULES_LABEL.json and INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.json also byte-identical

claim_ceiling: The component decides the SUPPORT OF counter labels AS ISSUED under the frozen support rubric. It NEVER asserts that any specific decision IS supporting, contrary or limiting; the product never writes such an assertion either. The abstention count and the emitted-label count are published side by side so the yield/support trade is auditable.
what_product_does_not_claim: any recomputed frozen-rubric support rate for product bundles (re-measuring labels is Frontier's and Core Evaluation's job, not the product lane's)
that the Frontier-measured 5/5 support-among-emitted rate transfers to any other population
any counter-label, geometry or human-gate bar being met; both accepted bars stay unmet and the DO-NOT-SERVE order on packet 38839347028 stands
lane_write_scope_note: the accepted mount keeps the team namespace frontier/frontier-counter-anchor-classifier; the product lane vendors it under product/vendor/ because the core-lane workflow write scope admits only product/, tests/product/, results/product/, reports/product/, state/product.json and data/product/
